description.value: Ramson's Pizza and Bar is a neighbourhood pizza restaurant on West 16th Avenue in Vancouver, known for thin-crust pizzas made with natural ingredients. Reviewers consistently call it a 'hidden gem' with a casual atmosphere and notably friendly staff. Cyclists can order online for pickup or dine in at this locally beloved spot.
